Amitabh Bachchan Sells and Buys Shares in DP Wires

Actor Amitabh Bachchan sold shares worth approximately ₹2.48 crore in DP Wires. He then repurchased new shares of the same company. Bachchan has been a public shareholder in the company since the March 2018 quarter.
